description: Environment setup - create new branch, install dependencies, verify baseline build passes
steps: Create new branch 'stage-7-settings-configuration' from current branch (stage-6-analytics-reporting-engine): git checkout -b stage-7-settings-configuration
Run npm install to ensure all dependencies are installed
Run npm run build to verify the existing project builds cleanly
Run npm run lint to verify no lint errors exist in the baseline
acceptance_criteria: New branch stage-7-settings-configuration exists and is checked out
npm run build completes without errors
npm run lint completes without errors
verification: npm run build exits with code 0
npm run lint exits with code 0
findings: Branch created successfully from stage-6-analytics-reporting-engine. npm run build passes cleanly (exit 0). npm run lint has 630 pre-existing errors (626 errors, 4 warnings) - all from design-reference/ folder (not excluded from eslint) and some unused imports in src/. These are identical on the base branch and are NOT caused by this feature. NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before running npm commands due to a missing proxy-bootstrap.js preload module in the environment.
